notes: S4 (decision 2026-11-18 #4, decided by principle), S4/H1 (§4.4, §5.3): a container with two declarations of fresh keys. The first declares a key as human and is signed by that key only: untrusted (E_KEY_UNTRUSTED, N_SELF_ATTESTED_ROOT_KEY), but it passes the §14.1 structural group and has no other signature, so it supplies material for a cosignature on another declaration and governs its key's class. The second declares a key as organization, self-signed, cosigned by org-1 (trusted) and by the first key: valid. Its cosignature by the first key is a valid signature by a key declared human (trust is not part of the test), so N_NO_HUMAN_SIGNATURE is not reported. The Python verifier read the class of trusted declarations only and reported the notice.
